content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance setting up a connection between [product_name] version 8 and [product_name] PLC, but I'm unsure how to proceed.

The most recent post from [user_name] was in 2018, so it is unlikely you'll get a reply. If you need assistance, feel free to share your requirements.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are trying to set up communication between [product_name] version 8 and [product_name] PLCs, facing challenges due to protocol differences and configuration obstacles, especially involving network settings and TSAP. Most resources and examples target earlier versions, leaving uncertainty about compatibility and setup for version 8, which is causing confusion and integration difficulties.
